entities.name: Santa Chiara a Vigna Clara
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Church of Saint Clare in Vigna Clara is a Catholic titular church in Rome, Italy, built as a parish church by decree of Cardinal Clemente Micara. In 1969 Pope Paul VI granted it a titular church as a seat for Cardinals.
